description: Bahrain's Ministry of Health publishes two sets of statistics on the country's health system. The annual health statistics, available for 2012 to 2022 in HTML and PDF, are the ministry's yearly compilation of health system figures. A newer open health data section, marked beta, provides XLSX files for births, deaths and infant mortality and pages on visits to primary health centres and to emergency departments. Coverage is national, with some tables by facility or governorate. Both are free and available to download from the ministry site in Arabic and English; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the annual statistics stop at 2022 on the pages read, the open data section is a beta with few files, and definitions are only given in the report chapters. Simulation uses: estimating the baseline load on emergency departments and health centres, sizing capacity against population growth and checking how facility use changes during heat or epidemic events. Related records: the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparable Gulf figures, and Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) maps facilities in Bahrain.
